description: This file defines an Express router handling the '/details' GET endpoint for retrieving cost details related to LLM usage, grouped by user, project, and agent, with support for filtering by date range and user ID. It constructs a complex MongoDB aggregation pipeline to normalize and process various cost-related fields, fetches data from a collection, and formats the response with project and agent details, including cost and token usage, with additional resolution of project names via an external service.
